evidence.summary: Card-specific Visa Infinite Guide to Benefits (effective 2026-06-11) governing Primary Auto Rental CDW ($75k cap, NY resident exception), Trip Cancellation/Interruption ($10k/person, $20k/trip), Trip Delay (>6h, $500/ticket), Baggage Delay ($100/day x 5 days), Lost Luggage, Emergency Evacuation, Purchase/Return Protection, Extended Warranty, and Visa Infinite Concierge/Luxury Hotel Collection.
evidence.title: Chase Sapphire Reserve Visa Infinite Guide to Benefits (BGC11559)

restrictions: New York State residents with personal U.S. auto insurance receive secondary coverage inside the U.S. and primary outside the U.S.
proposed_rule.summary: Standard Visa Infinite secondary auto CDW baseline is superseded on Chase Sapphire Reserve by card-specific Primary Auto Rental CDW up to $75,000.
